finding.statement: The prior downstream inference-receipt path accepted a RouteDecision produced from a caller-constructed bare EngineAdmission plus an admitted engine-artifact mapping, without requiring the byte-verifying HCU_VERIFIED_ENGINE_ADMISSION_RECEIPT/v1 to be admitted and rebound downstream.
finding.source_falsifier: The prior test_inference_receipt_v1.py constructed EngineAdmission directly and then produced a candidate inference receipt; this demonstrated that producer provenance was not part of downstream receipt admission at source-contract scope.

mechanism: require engine_admission_receipt_sha256 for downstream inference receipt production
require admission of the referenced HCU_VERIFIED_ENGINE_ADMISSION_RECEIPT/v1
bind entity generation, engine identity, engine class and engine artifact bundle
commit verified engine-admission receipt identity into downstream inference receipt identity

parallel_fusion.note: Parallel work on the same retained PR1263 lane subsequently strengthened inference receipt production further with a generation-fenced physical engine-load lease and loader-consumed-byte binding requirement. The test blob from this delta remains present. No competing route/Entry/engine authority was created.

experiment_accounting.reason: Current retained PR1263 coordination state records that the 23:57 go macrocycle unusual-experiment allowance was already consumed by AUTHORITY_CONSTANT_TRANSPLANT. The trust-boundary check and subsequent probes here are recorded only as source falsification/regression/component verification and do not consume or claim a second unusual experiment.

next_discriminator: On an actually-started authorized isolated executor, bind exact current EntityOS/HCU source + RFC8785 versioned Entry/route/GridPlan identities + verified engine admission + generation-fenced physical loader lease + actual loader-consumed artifact identity + downstream inference echo in one HCU_ENGINE_ADMISSION_CAUSAL_BINDING_RECEIPT/v1; reject mixed/downgraded canonicalization, stale lease generation, mismatched loader bytes and receiptless engine admission.
